import numpy as np
om=np.concatenate([np.eye(3),-np.eye(3),np.array([[x,y,z] for x in (-1.,1.) for y in (-1.,1.) for z in (-1.,1.)])/np.sqrt(3)]);wt=np.r_[np.full(6,1/12),np.full(8,1/16)]
n=12;seed=1;eps=1/768;st=1.
def synthetic_inputs(n, om, st, eps, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    X = rng.standard_normal((n, n))
    M = X @ X.T / n + 0.02 * np.eye(n)
    E, P, G, H = rng.standard_normal((4, 3, n, n))
    V = np.einsum('mk,ml->mkl', om, om) - np.eye(3) / 3
    A = np.einsum('mk,kij->mij', om, E - E.transpose(0, 2, 1)) + np.einsum('mk,kij->mij', abs(om), P @ P.transpose(0, 2, 1) / n)
    B = st / eps * M + 0.4 * A
    data = np.stack([np.broadcast_to(M, B.shape), B, 20 * np.einsum('mk,kij->mij', om, G)], axis=1)
    return data, 20 * np.einsum('mk,kij->mij', om, H) + 10 * np.einsum('mkl,klij->mij', V, rng.standard_normal((3, 3, n, n)))
data,lifting=synthetic_inputs(n,om,st,eps,seed)
assert np.allclose(#case:normal
solve_mean_zero_micro_action(data,lifting,eps,st,om,wt), target)
